app_name.description: Name of the design prototype, shown as the page title and main heading.

placeholder_body.message: Página provisória. As páginas do protótipo chegam nos próximos marcos.
placeholder_body.description: Explains that this page is temporary and will be replaced by real prototype pages.

placeholder_locale.description: Shows which language the page is currently displayed in.

popup_title.description: Name shown in the popup header.

popup_history.description: Header link that opens the History page.

popup_page_heading.description: Heading of the list of media found on the current page.

popup_untitled.description: Shown when a detected item has no title.

popup_duration_unknown.description: Shown instead of the duration when it is not known.

popup_duration_live.description: Label for a live broadcast, in place of the duration.

popup_btn_download.description: Saves the item with the default choices.

popup_btn_record.description: Starts recording a live item with the default choices.

popup_btn_choices.description: Opens the quality, audio and subtitle choices of an item.

popup_btn_cancel.description: Cancels a download and discards what was saved.

popup_btn_stop.description: Ends a live recording and keeps what was recorded. Different from Cancel.

popup_btn_dismiss.description: Removes a finished or failed download from the list.

popup_btn_back.description: Returns to the previous view of the popup.

popup_btn_more_jobs.description: Opens the item view when an item has more downloads than the row can show.

popup_protected_label.message: Protegido: o Servare não pode salvar este.
popup_protected_label.description: Calm label on a protected video.

popup_protected_why.message: O site protege este vídeo, e o Servare não contorna proteções.
popup_protected_why.description: Explanation shown by the Why disclosure on a protected video.

popup_status_waiting.description: Status of a download waiting for another one from the same site.

popup_status_running_size.description: Progress of a running download whose total size is unknown.

popup_status_paused_live.description: Status of a paused live recording.

popup_status_failed.description: Short status of a failed download.

popup_status_done.description: Short status of a finished download.

popup_err_auth.message: Abra a página, reproduza o vídeo uma vez e tente de novo.
popup_err_auth.description: Short next step for a download the site refused (HTTP 401 or 403).

popup_err_http.message: O site não enviou o vídeo. Tente de novo mais tarde.
popup_err_http.description: Short next step for other HTTP errors.

popup_err_incomplete.message: Só uma parte chegou. Tente de novo.
popup_err_incomplete.description: Short next step for an incomplete download.

popup_err_quota.message: Libere espaço no disco e tente de novo.
popup_err_quota.description: Short next step when the computer is out of space.

popup_err_decrypt.message: Não foi possível ler o vídeo. Tente de novo.
popup_err_decrypt.description: Short next step for a decrypt error.

popup_err_unknown.message: Algo deu errado. Tente de novo.
popup_err_unknown.description: Short next step for an unknown error.

popup_choices_heading.description: Heading of the choices of one item.

popup_quality_height.description: Quality choice named by its height in pixels.

popup_quality_option.description: Quality choice with no known size.

popup_audio_track.description: Audio choice with no name or language.

popup_subtitle_track.description: Subtitle choice with no name or language.

popup_audio_only.description: Option to save only the sound as MP3.

popup_tag_mp3.description: Small label on a download that saves only the sound.

popup_group_attention.description: Group of failed or waiting downloads.

popup_group_active.description: Group of running, paused and queued downloads.

popup_group_finished.description: Group of finished and cancelled downloads.

popup_job_media_gone.description: Shown on a download whose video left the current page.

popup_item_jobs.description: Heading of the list of jobs of one item.

popup_item_none.description: Shown in the item view when the item has no downloads.

popup_summary_active.description: Count of active downloads in the summary.

popup_summary_attention.description: Count of downloads that need attention in the summary.

popup_summary_all.description: Count of downloads in the summary when none is active.

popup_summary_join.description: Joins two parts of the downloads summary.

popup_summary_label.description: Accessible name of the summary button.
